sources.recommended_method: For structured collection use the official DevelopmentAid External API (https://www.developmentaid.org/api/external) with a purchased membership api-key. Requires commercial subscription decision.

ASP.NET WebForms postback: GET the .aspx page (keep session cookie), scrape __VIEWSTATE/__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR/__EVENTVALIDATION, then POST with __EVENTTARGET=dataPoMjesecima$ctrlN$ctlMM$linkToFile for the desired month. Server returns Content-Disposition attachment filename EOJN_OCD_DD_MM_YYYY.zip (application/octet-stream) holding an OCDS JSON. Tested: Feb-2018 file downloaded (121,974 bytes, valid ZIP). No login required. Iterate targets ctrl0..ctrlN to cover all months 2018-2026.

Scrape the annual-reports page (and careers/news pages) for /en/documents/[id] links, then HTTP GET each document id to fetch the PDF (Content-Type application/pdf, Content-Disposition filename provided). No JS or auth required. For jobs (A5) crawl https://www.procreditbank.bg/en/careers; for corporate news (A1) crawl /en/about-us/notifications-and-news/news; for supplier/ESG (A6) crawl /en/about-us/esg-sustainability.

Poll RSS feeds and parse XML <item> nodes: https://www.bankingnews.gr/rss (all articles), https://www.bankingnews.gr/rss/trapezika-nea (banking news, A4/A6), https://www.bankingnews.gr/rss/deltia-typou (press releases, A2). No auth, no JS. HTML article pages linked from feed for full text.

Scrape the oikonomika-stoixeia HTML page for <a href=*.pdf> links (paths under /images/ and /images/pdf_upload/), then GET each annual report PDF. Also scrape /el/trapeza/nea-anakoinoseis for announcements (A1) and the PSD2 developer page /el/psifiakes-ypiresies/psd2-developer-programm (A6). Static HTML, no auth.

Poll https://lidermedia.hr/rss.xml for new articles (site-wide feed, includes Financije/kripto items). WordPress-style /feed/ does NOT exist (404); use /rss.xml.

WordPress site: scrape /index.php/finansijski-izvjestaji/ for hrefs to /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf (annual reports, auditor reports, EN + SR statements). Scrape /index.php/novosti/ and /index.php/karijera/ (or /index.php/category/karijera/) for A5 early-intent/careers and A1/A3 news.

Use sitemap index https://www.scalefocus.com/sitemaps.xml to enumerate URLs from case-studies-sitemap1.xml (A6/A2 finance case studies) and positions-sitemap1.xml (A5 jobs), then scrape each HTML page. Scrape /en/investors/reports/annual-reports/ and .../quarterly-half-year-reports/ pages for /media/*.pdf links (direct, no auth) and download the report PDFs; mirror /hr/ Croatian versions. Careers listings under /en/careers/ for A6. For latest regulatory filings, cross-check ZSE (zse.hr) issuer page for SPAN.

Download the annual XLSX/PDF from the publications page. Direct PDF returns HTTP 200 application/pdf (content-length ~3.88 MB). Scrape the /our-publications/startups-in-greece/ page each December for the new year's PDF link (WordPress /wp-content/uploads/ path).

Scrape the topic listing pages (e.g. /en/finance-capital-markets/, /en/markets-sectors/, paginated) for study landing pages, then download the study PDFs which live under https://iobe.gr/wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/RES_*.pdf (EN = _EN.pdf, GR = _GR.pdf). Static HTML + direct PDF, no auth, no JS.

Fetch sitemap.xml (index) -> parse sitemap-news.xml for fresh articles and sitemaps/post-sitemap-1..3.xml for the archive, then scrape article HTML. Use a browser User-Agent (Cloudflare). RSS /feed/ is 404, so use the sitemaps.

Scrape the financial-press-releases HTML listing (chronological, 2026 releases visible, 'Archives' link for history). For reports, download PDFs from Results & Reports (https://investors.worldline.com/en/home/results-reports) and Reports Archives; PDFs live under /content/dam/investors-worldline-com/assets/documents/ and support HTTP range requests.

Direct HTTP GET of the .xlsx files under /web/files/documents/... (tested: HTTP 200, content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 11.4KB). Scrape /bg/za-fgvb/statistika for current file links; scrape /bg/za-vlojitelite/banki for the member-bank list. No login required.

Collect via a real browser / headless Chrome (Cloudflare returns 403 to curl/WebFetch; content is client-side rendered). Best structured entry point is the Google-News sitemap index at https://scantv.al/sitemap.xml (200, text/xml, verified from a browser session) — pull article URLs, then render category/article pages (/ekonomi/, /scan-intel/, /english/). Not WordPress (no /wp-json, /feed = 404 -> custom CMS).

Crawl individual project records by ID at /projects/{IFI}-{num}/ (public, no login) and pull the structured PDF at /projects/{IFI}-{num}/pdf/ (302 -> temp PDF, 200 application/pdf, ~62KB tested). Filter by country=Albania/Bosnia and sector=Finance/Banking. Full search/browse of the DB requires free registration (ewsdata login), but direct project + PDF URLs do not.

Scrape the report index pages (/izvjesca-o-radu, /posebna-izvjesca) for href=*.pdf links (hosted under /sites/default/files/dokumenti/ and /images/stories/novosti/), then download each PDF and parse. Static Drupal HTML - no JS or auth.
Poll RSS at https://etto.ba/feed.rss (valid RSS 2.0, tested) or Atom at https://etto.ba/feed.atom; filter items for bank/payments keywords. A6 media monitoring for Bosnia.

Poll https://abanksb.bg/en/bulletin/ for new quarterly issues; direct PDFs follow predictable pattern https://abanksb.bg/bulletin/{n}-en.pdf (EN) and /bulletin/{n}.pdf (BG). Scrape member lists at /en/full-members/ and /en/associated-members/, press at /en/category/press-en/.

Scrape the sektorske-analize listing page for /userdocsimages/.../*.pdf links and download PDFs; predictable path pattern (SA_<sector>_<year>.pdf)

Scrape the register page for the current CSV/PDF href (path /documents/... with a versioned ?t= timestamp) then GET the CSV directly. CSV is semicolon-delimited (Croatian), ~16KB, sections: payment institutions, small payment institutions, AISPs, e-money institutions, etc. Two PDFs also linked (register + expired/removed entities).

Scrape HTML listing pages: Greece press releases (https://www.deloitte.com/gr/en/about/press-room/press-releases.html) and industry/insights hubs (banking-capital-markets, financial-services, tax alerts). Headlines/links are server-rendered in the HTML, so a plain GET + HTML parse works, no browser session or auth needed. For research reports (Digital Banking Maturity, Regulatory Outlook) follow article pages to linked PDFs and download individually as needed.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML announcement table at https://athens.euronext.com/en/market-data/announcements, paginating with ?page=N (page=0..N); each row links to /en/more-options/announcements/announcement-<id>. Use a browser-like User-Agent (curl works; the old www.athexgroup.gr host 403s bots on legacy paths but the euronext host serves fine). For a specific issuer use /en/market-data/issuers/<id>/announcements (e.g. 278=Alpha Bank) — note that page's announcement list is loaded by a separate Drupal view AJAX block ('announcements-displays-final'), so per-issuer needs either the aggregated page filtered by issuer or a browser session; the aggregated page is the simplest collection target. Greek versions via /el/ prefix.

Scrape HTML insight/industry pages. Poll the regulatory-insights hub (https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/regulatory-insights.html) and the annual '20xx Financial Services Regulatory Priorities' articles for A3; scrape Greece People Services pages (executive-search-selection.html, compensation-benefits-surveys.html) and industries/banking.html for A2/A5. Follow /home/ -> non-/home/ 301 redirects. Some barometer/radar reports link to PDFs behind marketing/registration forms — flag those individually.

Scrape paginated HTML: GET https://www.temenos.com/press-releases/page/N/ (N=1..54, path-based pagination returns server-rendered HTML, no JS/auth needed). Filter deal/partner/go-live announcements; parse date-stamped entries. Same pattern applies to https://www.temenos.com/success-stories/ for customer case studies.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML of the hub pages (BCM industry page, /en_gr/technical/tax/tax-alerts, and en_gl EMEIA insight URLs) and follow article links; content is present in HTML (AEM), no auth/JS needed. Use a browser-like User-Agent.

Scrape investors.dieboldnixdorf.com/news-and-events/press-releases (IR platform, year-indexed URLs .../press-releases/news-details/2026/...) or news.dieboldnixdorf.com/press-releases. IR sites usually expose an RSS feed - check for one.

Scrape the HTML project register at https://www.eib.org/en/projects/loans/index.htm?countries=GR (signed loans) and https://www.eib.org/en/projects/all/ (paginated); also monitor procurement page https://www.eib.org/en/about/procurement/index. No public CSV/JSON export; data.europa.eu EIB dataset distributions merely link back to these HTML pages. All three sample URLs return HTTP 200.

Static HTTP GET scraping. Fetch https://www.payten.com/en/news-events/news/ (nginx, 200, text/html, fully server-rendered — no browser/JS required). Parse article links matching the pattern /en/news-events/news/{slug}/ and follow pagination via ?page=N (?page=2 returns 200). Each article page is plain HTML with title, date and body. Poll periodically for A6 competitor/vendor intelligence. For product/offer pages (e.g. /en/offers/for-merchants/payment-acceptance/, /en/offers/for-payment-financial-institutions/atm-related-services/moneyget-atm-network/) fetch directly, also static HTML.

HTTP GET on server-rendered pages: /press (EN newsroom) and /hr-HR/novosti (Croatian news/blog), paginate via ?p=N (e.g. /press?p=1). Also /hr-HR/regulatory-info (A3 regulation) and /about (A1). Content is present in raw HTML, so plain curl/HTTP fetch works without a browser. For job openings (A5), the /careers page renders the list via a Talentlyft JS widget (talentlyftWidget) rather than server HTML, so use the Talentlyft feed/widget or a headless browser for jobs specifically.

Static HTML scraping. Crawl section landing pages (news /bs/novosti/kratke-vijesti and /bs/novosti/bhbankar, events /bs/dogadjaji, jobs /bs/novosti/zaposljavanje, tag pages e.g. /bs/novosti/tag/platni_promet, member banks /bs/banke-clanice, documents /bs/dokumenti/prezentacije) then follow item detail links. English mirror under /en. Pages are server-rendered, so plain HTTP GET + HTML parser (BeautifulSoup/Cheerio) works; no JS execution or login needed. robots.txt allows all crawling. Downloadable files (PDF/PPT White Books, presentations) live on document detail pages - follow through to capture direct file links.
Scrape HTML. Paginate the awards-ranking hub (52 pages) and winner-announcements list; filter articles mentioning Greece / Best Bank in Greece. Server-rendered, no auth.

Scrape HTML at https://ingenico.com/en/newsroom/press-releases and /en/newsroom/blogs; follow ?page=N pagination ('Show me more' link). Item links follow /en/newsroom/press-releases/<slug>. No auth, no RSS observed.

Scrape HTML. Start from all-results index and country-award archive (https://www.euromoney.com/awards-articles/country-award/), follow the yearly 'national winners ... Greece' article URLs. Server-rendered content is retrievable without JS/login. Full award-entry portal (euromoney.awardsplatform.com) requires submission login and is not needed for winner lists.

Poll RSS feeds on a schedule with a plain HTTP GET (no JS, no auth). Use https://www.bug.hr/rss for all posts, https://www.bug.hr/rss/biznis for business/IT, and https://www.bug.hr/rss/fintech for fintech/payments/crypto/regulation. Feeds are RSS 2.0 with <title>, <link>, <category>, <description>, <pubDate>. Pattern is https://www.bug.hr/rss/<section-or-tag>. For deeper article text, follow each item <link> and scrape the static HTML. ttl=30 min, so poll ~30-60 min.

Scrape HTML list at https://www.epant.gr/apofaseis-gnomodotiseis.html (EL) or /en/decisions.html (EN), paginating with ?start=N (increments of ~23; 45 pages EL / 16 EN). Follow item links to /apofaseis-gnomodotiseis/item/<id>-*.html to get full decision text and PDF links. Can also filter by year-tag URLs or company tags (e.g. Piraeus Bank). For sector inquiries, download PDF reports directly from /files/<year>/*.pdf. No auth, no JS, no API needed — plain GET + HTML parse.

Scrape the blog index (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/blog -> redirects to /blog-international), the press/newsroom page (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/press, 'More press releases...' link), and localized editions (Bulgarian: https://www.paysera.com/v2/bg/blog-bulgaria; Albania articles under /v2/en/blog/*-albania). Article titles + dates are in server-rendered HTML (curl/WebFetch works on article/blog/press pages). Use a realistic browser User-Agent because the site root returns HTTP 403 to bare curl (bot protection); article and section pages return 200. Career/jobs at /v2/en/career for A5. No RSS feed found.

GET each page with a real browser User-Agent header (site is behind Cloudflare which 403s default/WebFetch agents but serves 200 to a normal Mozilla UA); parse the embedded <script type=application/ld+json> ItemList to get job name + url for each listing (confirmed: 50 ListItem entries per results page, e.g. name='Cost Control Senior Associate' url=/jobs/finance-jobs/289831). Paginate results pages; harvest company profiles at /companies/<slug>. No auth needed.

Scrape server-rendered HTML. Recommendations register: GET https://www.synigoroskatanaloti.gr/el/systaseis-porismata?page=N (57 pages, 0-indexed); filter Financial Services via subject-category facet. Each item is an HTML decision page; follow for text/PDF. Annual reports: /en(or el)/annual-report-YYYY pages (2005-2021), PDFs on each report page. News by category: /el/nea?field_category_target_id=3.
Scrape the static HTML newsroom card grid at /newsroom and follow 'Browse All' to the knowledge hub. No RSS/JSON found; periodic HTML scrape. Cloudflare-fronted, /en/global paths 301 to root.

Scrape HTML from https://ethosevents.eu/en/upcoming-events/ for event names + dates (static, category-tabbed), and per-event pages under /en/event/<slug>/ for agenda/sponsors/speakers (A5 early-intent, A6 vendors). Apologismoi recaps under /apologismoi/<slug>/. EN and EL variants exist.

Poll RSS feeds https://www.bta.bg/en/rss/free (English) and https://www.bta.bg/bg/rss/free (Bulgarian) via simple HTTP GET (text/xml, no auth, updatePeriod hourly) for new items; for section pages fetch HTML listings like https://www.bta.bg/en/news/economy and follow article links (e.g. /en/news/671544-... which returns 200). No JS needed for server-rendered HTML.

Scrape HTML pages (banke-prihvatitelji, blog, cesto-postavljana-pitanja, en/ mirror) but SET A BROWSER User-Agent — default curl/bot UA returns HTTP 403 (bot protection). With a Mozilla UA pages return 200. Both HR and EN (/en/) versions exist; use /en/blog/ for English content.

Poll the RSS feeds (e.g. https://www.economic.bg/rss/all.xml for all news, https://www.economic.bg/rss/biznes.xml, /rss/sektorni-novini.xml, /rss/biznes-radar.xml) for A1/A3/A5/A6 monitoring; supplement with HTML scraping of the Finance/Banks category page (/bg/category/finansi/banki.html) which is server-rendered and paginated. No JS or auth needed. Filter items by bank/ABB/fintech keywords.

Scrape the izvjestaji-emitenta and godisnji-izvjestaji index pages for the dated PDF/XLSX links, then fetch each report file directly over HTTPS (static server, no JS/API needed). Also monitor /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/saopcenja1 (press) and /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/finansijski-kalendar for A3 deadlines.

download.type: PDF (Visa fact sheet, Visa Direct fact sheets, corporate media kit)

Scrape the media-centar listing page (HTTP 200, static server-rendered HTML) with plain HTTP GET; parse dated items and follow individual article links. Filter via on-page categories: Sve novosti / Vijesti / Priopcenja. Poll periodically for new-dated items.

HTTP GET scraping of the stable path pattern https://www.infostock.bg/infostock/control/{section}/{TICKER} where section = quotes | statements | issuenews | institutions | bse. Enumerate issuers via /infostock/control/institutions, then pull quotes/statements/issuenews per ticker.

Static HTML scrape of /speakers/, /startups/, /news/ and /agenda with a simple HTTP GET + HTML parser (WordPress-style markup, speaker/startup cards embedded in DOM, no JS execution needed). Re-crawl per conference edition; watch for yearly URL/edition changes.

Retarget collection to the successors: (1) Erste Bank Croatia press releases https://www.erstebank.hr/hr/press/priopcenja-za-medije (A1/A5 news) and financial reports https://www.erstebank.hr/hr/o-nama/financijska-izvjesca (A1 PDFs); (2) Diners Club Hrvatska https://diners.hr/ (card products/news); (3) Global Payments corporate news for the acquiring business; (4) Croatian court register (sudreg.pravosudje.hr) / FINA for Erste Card Club d.o.o. company & management data. Scrape via plain HTTP/HTML; no API or auth needed.
Scrape section index pages (e.g. /banke/) for article links + dates, then fetch article HTML. RSS probes (/feed,/rss) only redirect to HTML, so use section-list scraping with pagination

Scrape https://newsroom.mastercard.com/news/press/ (releases grouped by year, reverse-chronological) and follow per-release article pages; use the Europe region filter for EU-relevant items. No RSS/WP/JSON feed exposed, so plain HTML scraping (or WebSearch site: filter).

HTTP GET + HTML scrape of corporate pages and /en/blog/ (and SQ equivalents) for A1 corporate/newsroom, A6 vendor/competitor profiling; /en/karriera/ for A5 jobs/early-intent. Server-rendered, no auth.

download.type: PDF (annual/yearly financial statements, linked from press center)

For financials, scrape the linked 'Годишни финансови отчети' (financial-statements.html) page for annual report PDFs. English mirror under /en_BG/. No JS needed.

Static HTML scrape of /en/banking-finances/ and /en/ plus blog/news links for vendor offerings, financial-sector case studies and client references. No API/downloads; monitor newsroom for banking wins.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML table at /country/greece (columns: Name, Markets, Developer Portal, Bank Stack, AIS, PIS, APIs). For depth, scrape per-provider pages /provider/<slug> (e.g. atticabank-gr) for API standard (BERLIN), BIC, developer portal URL and API products. No JS or auth needed.

Scrape HTML announcement listing at /en/group/press-office/ (EN) and /omilos/grafeio-typou/ (EL); items are per-year sub-paths (/YYYY/slug/). Use GET requests (server returns 200 on GET; HEAD requests are rejected with 404). For jobs (A5) scrape /omilos/anthropino-dunamiko/.../diathesimes-theseis-ergasias/.

Download the Greece OCDS bulk file (full or yearly .jsonl.gz, ~66MB full) from https://opentender.eu/download; refreshed ~every 6 months. Registry page lists format/size. Parse OCDS JSON lines.
Scrape the Greece financial-assistance HTML page for PDF links (PPS reports released biannually - spring/autumn); download each new PPS report PDF. No auth. New reports approx every 6 months.

gov.gr pages are static HTML info hubs (scrape trivially). Treat each target portal as its own source in the tracker.

Poll RSS feed https://financialit.net/rss.xml (HTTP 200, content-type application/rss+xml) for new items, then HTTP GET individual /news/... article pages (static HTML, no JS/login) for full press-release text. Filter by SEE country/vendor keywords for A2/A5/A6 signals.

Periodic HTML scrape of the English (/en/...) and Albanian sections — About Us, Products & Services, Activities, Job Vacancies, Contact — for corporate profile (A1), vendor/competitor intel (A6) and early-intent signals (A5). Content is fully static; simple GET + HTML parse works, no JS/API needed.

Scrape with a real browser User-Agent. Plain curl (default UA) returns HTTP 403 (WAF/bot protection) on the homepage and all sample paths, but WebFetch (browser-like UA) retrieves full content. Set a normal browser User-Agent header, or use a headless browser, then crawl /projects/, /ict-projects/, newshub and /careers/. Careers page has no live vacancy list, it routes to an 'Open Application' talent-platform link; watch the newshub for reference/project announcements.

Scrape server-rendered HTML of /nabavke-i-pozivi/ and /obavjestenja/; follow 'Vidi arhivu' archive links to enumerate dated notices; fetch linked PDF tender documents. Dropdown filters (value/region/work-type) are light JS enhancement over server content — not required for scraping.

Scrape the Serbian/English regional site under /sr_en/ (relevant for Bosnia + Croatia) for solutions, references and any news; Slovenian /sl/ and Slovenian-English /sl_en/ locales also exist. Static HTML, no JS/login. Watch solutions + careers + cybersecurity pages for product/market signals.

Static HTML scrape of /banking-references (client banks: Slatinska, Istarska kreditna, Jadranska, Podravska, Splitska/SocGen, Bosna Bank International, etc.), /banking-solutions and the news blocks. No JS or API needed; nginx serves plain HTML with HTTP 200.

Scrape the server-rendered /new-blog archive page (all articles listed by year on one page, no pagination); follow article links for full text. Also /way4-payment-platform and case-studies pages for A6 vendor detail. Re-crawl periodically for new dated entries.

Scrape the static HTML service/category pages (/c/51/pagesa payments, /transferta-parash money transfer, /d/82/arketime bill-collection). For fees/tariffs follow the referenced 'Tarifa e Sherbimeve Postare' and 'Lista e Cmimeve' links (likely PDF). For A1/A4 financial reports, search site for 'raporti vjetor'/annual report separately (not on these pages).

Browser-session or WebFetch scrape of finacle.com/news-room/ and infosys.com/newsroom/press-releases.html; direct curl is Akamai bot-blocked (403). Use realistic User-Agent/headless browser.

Scrape the news-press HTML page (server-rendered CMS); iterate the year filter (2005–2026) to enumerate items and follow each 'MORE' link to the full article. No auth/JS needed. Also harvest footer PDFs for fees/agreements. Greek version likely at /news-press/ without /en/.
Scrape HTML article; award winners are structured as country/winner lists within the page. No auth. Repeat annually with /awards/world-finance-banking-awards-<year> URL pattern.
Scrape HTML tender lists from www2.dgmarket.com with a browser User-Agent (Greece country filter). Avoid the legacy www.dgmarket.com/tenders/list.do path which returns 403 (Cloudflare).

Static HTTP GET + HTML parse of /bg/jobs (careers, A5/A6) and /bg/news (corporate news, A3/A6). No auth, no JS. English variants under /en/. Poll periodically for new openings/news.

Periodic HTTP GET + HTML parse of the /portal/en/tenders/ (or /bs/ which 301s to /en/) section; individual tender announcements are server-rendered pages, PDFs linked per-item. Also /portal/en/taxpayer-database/ for A1/A6.

HTTP GET + HTML parse of stories.html (case studies), news.html and insights.html for banking/fintech client wins; industries/fintech.html and services pages for solution/competitor intel. Server-rendered, no JS/API.

HTTP scrape of the paginated finansije section (server-side rendered HTML, ~38 pages). Iterate pagination links; parse article cards/headlines. No login needed.
